question: Can an AI invocation stop at an external wait and another invocation safely continue from Git alone?
hypothesis: Durable WORK refs with leases and explicit await continuations let a fresh agent resume correctly without chat history, while compare-and-swap ref updates prevent silent concurrent state loss.

evidence.observation: Fresh invocation recovered the awaiting WORK ref from Git, independently verified the referenced workflow run concluded success, and selected the encoded success continuation without prior chat context.
evidence.continuation: add declarative WORK scopes and compact overlap/conflict reporting
